_readme: One entry per Play Store phone screenshot, in display order. 'raw' is a file in raw/ (a real capture from the app, 1080x2400). 'offset' (0-1) picks which vertical part of the capture shows; 0 = top. Entries with 'todo' are captures you still need to take on your phone; they are skipped until the raw file exists.
